recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-37867 unless future search-parameter generation introduces a path ending at CodeableReference.
issue_request: FHIR-37867 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue asking the search summary tables and related search handling to account for CodeableReference after R4B introduced the datatype and ClinicalUseDefinition search parameters used it. The final resolution was to avoid paths ending at CodeableReference and instead use CodeableReference.concept or CodeableReference.reference.
initial_application: Commit 211e70eb7d9e1f2114659e1724230b660e5f5ce8 applied the issue by adding a CodeableReference row to source/search.html's search type/datatype cross-map. The row uses the existing xcmchk not-used-in-search pattern and says searches either refer to .concept or .reference.
additional_context: CodeableReference remains an active datatype and ClinicalUseDefinition remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Current ClinicalUseDefinition search parameters use .concept for token searches and .reference for reference searches, and a repository-wide check of checked-in search-parameter bundles found no path or expression ending at CodeableReference. Zulip discussion before the Jira resolution supports the same concept/reference split, and no FHIR-37867-specific Zulip or Confluence conflict was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current search summary table and current search-parameter sources already satisfy the final resolution.
